abstract: BACKGROUND: After chemotherapy for nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor (NSTGCT), residual masses or recurrent disease may contain a non-germ cell malignancy (NGCM). METHODS: Over 20 years, 369 patients with disseminated NSTGCT were treated with cisplatin-based polychemotherapy at the University Medical Center Groningen. Residual tumor masses were resected in 244 patients and recurrent tumor masses in 37 patients. Histology was reviewed, focusing on the presence of NGCM. RESULTS: Nine patients developed an NGCM. Four patients had an NGCM in the resected residual tumor mass after chemotherapy: three patients had a sarcoma, and one patient had both a sarcoma and an adenocarcinoma. Five patients developed a late recurrence with an NGCM after 39, 40, 72, 72, and 84 months. One patient had a primitive neuroectodermal tumor, one had a sarcoma, and three had an adenocarcinoma in the resected recurrent tumor mass. A complete surgical resection was achieved in five (56%) of the nine patients. After a median follow-up of 48 months (range, 3-271 months), five patients had no evidence of disease (56%), three patients were dead of disease (33%), and one patient was alive with disease (11%). CONCLUSIONS: Sarcoma, adenocarcinoma, or both in residual or recurrent tumor masses after combined-modality NSTGCT treatment are rare. Complete surgical resection of the tumor mass is the only curative treatment option.
abstract_ja:
背景：化学療法後の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍(NSTGCT)の残存腫瘤や再発腫瘍には、非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍(NGCM)が含まれることがある。
方法：20年間にわたり、播種性NSTGCT患者369例がシスプラチンを含む多剤化学療法で治療された。残存腫瘍は244例で、再発腫瘍は37例で切除された。組織所見を再検討し、NGCMの有無に着目した。
結果：9例がNGCMを発症した。化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除で4例にNGCMを認め、肉腫3例、肉腫と腺癌の併存1例であった。後期再発で5例にNGCMを認め（39、40、72、72、84か月後）、内訳は原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍1例、肉腫1例、腺癌3例であった。9例中5例（56%）で完全な外科的切除が達成された。追跡期間中央値は48か月（範囲3〜271か月）で、無病生存5例（56%）、原病死3例（33%）、生存のまま病変あり1例（11%）であった。
結論：NSTGCTの集学的治療後の残存または再発腫瘤における肉腫、腺癌、またはその両方は稀である。根治的治療となり得るのは、腫瘤の完全な外科的切除のみである。
